Featured tour packages

Open a package for the day-by-day plan, then book it with your travel date.

Kenya

5 days | Amboseli, Salt Lick, Tsavo West and Tsavo East

A southern circuit from Nairobi. Two nights in Amboseli for Kilimanjaro and elephants, then Tsavo West, the Salt Lick waterhole, and Tsavo East.

5 days / 4 nightsView details
Kenya

7 days | Ol Pejeta, Samburu, Lake Nakuru and Masai Mara

Conservancy, dry north, the Rift Valley lakes and the Mara. One long travel day is written into the plan so the rest of the trip is not a rush.

7 days / 6 nightsView details
Kenya

8 days | Tsavo, Amboseli, Lake Naivasha and Masai Mara

One itinerary, not two. Tsavo East and West, Amboseli, a Naivasha pause, then the Mara. Two of the days are long drives, and we say so before you book.

8 days / 7 nightsView details
Tanzania

6 days | Tarangire, Serengeti and Ngorongoro

Arusha, Tarangire’s elephants and baobabs, two nights in the Serengeti and a crater descent. We meet you in Arusha, or connect you from Nairobi.

6 days / 5 nightsView details
Uganda

5 days | Queen Elizabeth and Bwindi gorillas

Queen Elizabeth for classic game viewing and a boat, then Bwindi for one gorilla trek. The park permit is quoted separately because the fee is set by the park, not by us.

5 days / 4 nightsView details
Rwanda

4 days | Kigali and Volcanoes gorillas

Kigali, a night beside Volcanoes National Park, one gorilla trek, and a simple return. The permit is the largest cost and is quoted on its own.

4 days / 3 nightsView details
